topic: Why a company can report profit while cash is disappearing
central_idea: Profit is booked when a sale is invoiced; cash counts only when it lands in the account, and growth widens that gap instead of closing it.
engagement_goal: Saves and comments from people applying the cash-flow-statement check to companies they follow
